# DeepSage

> DeepSage teaches real-world skills -- AI literacy, data analysis, critical thinking, and more -- through short articles and interactive quizzes.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://deepsage.com/): what DeepSage is and how it works
- [Articles](https://deepsage.com/article/): full article index
- [Quizzes](https://deepsage.com/quiz/): full quiz index
- [Skills](https://deepsage.com/skills/): topic landing pages
- [Games](https://deepsage.com/games/): upcoming skill-building games (in development)
- [Books](https://deepsage.com/books/): one story-driven book per skill (in development)
